about: A SMALL SAMPLE of Poly Haven pictures and models (CC0 licence), read once from the public Poly Haven list on 23 October 2026: one or two pictures for each kind of surface the kit knows (ground, floors, walls, roofs, wood, metal) and a few everyday props from streets, yards and quays, so a helper sees what the names look like. It is NOT a shopping list for any place. Search the site for the surfaces and props YOUR place needs: https://polyhaven.com/textures and https://polyhaven.com/models, or the full lists https://api.polyhaven.com/assets?t=textures and https://api.polyhaven.com/assets?t=models (each entry gives its real size in millimetres under dimensions). NOTHING is shipped: fetch at run time. URL pattern for a texture map: https://dl.polyhaven.org/file/ph-assets/Textures/jpg/<1k|2k>/<id>/<id>_<map>_<1k|2k>.jpg. Use a generic agent name in the request and nothing personal. If Poly Haven has no model of a prop you need, build it in a script. Rules: pick a photo surface by drawing a small test plate; open every downloaded picture at full size and look for stickers, brands and digits (judgement); scans alone read bland, so designed marks and geometry go on top.
